name: Sommerrodelbahn Erbeskopf
sourceNuance: Current operator site reports the 2026 season closed; a late April or early May 2027 start is only tentative. The parent ENP page still contains an obsolete early-2026 planning notice; the current ride page takes precedence. The municipality quotes a different rounded track length; no length comparison is repeated in the public descriptions.

calendar.nuance: The 2026 season has ended. No 2027 opening date is set. Wet or rainy conditions halt operations during open season.

pricing: Operator currently displays adult 16+ €4.70/€13.50/€25/€37 and child 8–15 €4/€11/€21/€30 for 1/3/6/10 rides. Children 3–7 ride free with an adult. These are displayed rates, to reverify for 2027; no 2027 booking date is asserted.
